title: aster ciliatus
intro: Aster ciliatus, commonly known as Fringed Aster or Hair-Stem Aster, is a flowering plant species within the daisy family. It is native to the mountainous regions of China and has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Aster ciliatus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and sore throat. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral effects.
